summary: Cullinan Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 furnishing a press release that previews fourth-quarter 2026 clinical milestones for its T-cell engager pipeline. Management guided to December multi-dose and single-target-dose Phase 1 data for CLN-978 across refractory SLE, difficult-to-treat rheumatoid arthritis, and Sjogren's disease, November ACR Convergence 2026 poster data for velinotamig in SLE from partner Chongqing Genrix, and updated December Phase 1 relapse/refractory AML data for CLN-049. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed; the filing is a disclosure update, not a special situation, with binary clinical readouts the event risk to watch.
